title: 第3章 追出祖地第4章 不给机会
content_zh:
根据这黑斗袍人的话，林云几乎可以确定，源境确实还能继续提升！
至于他口中的宇宙海，那又是一个什么样的地方？
这些话，信息量实在太大，林云一时都无法完全消化。
林云此刻内心已经变得无比澎湃，血液里那股子热血劲儿，已经沸腾起来！
“你没有完全说实话。”
林云盯着他。
“你爱信不信！”
黑斗袍男人话音落下，便再度转身，抬手撕开空间裂缝。
林云早已经有准备，在他撕开裂缝时，林云心念一动，迅速对裂缝进行修复。
而这一次，黑斗袍男人也学聪明了。
他撕开裂缝后，双手一直扒着裂缝，双臂爆发出全部实力，阻止林云对裂缝的修复，同时想要往外硬挤！
“小子，你刚刚答应过，我回答完问题，就让我走！”
“你现在什么意思？！”
黑斗袍男人一边拼命阻止裂缝修复往外挤，一边怒骂连连。
“你这么急着走干嘛？既然你是外面来的，我这个做主人的，当然得好好招待你一番！”
林云嘴角扬起。
话音落下，林云手中宝剑再度激荡起炫丽光芒，源力、源之树能量与天道之力灌注之下，一剑暴掠向黑斗袍男人。
林云不放他走，原因很简单，林云从刚刚见到他起，就明显能够感觉到，这家伙十分觊觎祖地，尤其是觊觎前面的祖心界！
林云尚且不知道，他觊觎的原因是什么。
而且这家伙又是从所谓从宇宙海来的。

林云猜想，那边一定有比他更强大的存在，甚至有更强大的修炼体系。
要是放走他，下一次他再带更强的人来，要占领祖地怎么办？甚至发动战争怎么办？
自己作为祖地天道，必须有义务，担当起守护祖地的义务。
更何况自己的一切亲友，如今都在祖地，林云更加不能让祖地，有任何闪失的可能！
撕啦！
宝剑化作璀璨剑芒，所过之处，空间坍塌，转瞬间便抵达。
这黑斗袍男人，正在用手扒空间裂缝，而且整个人已经挤入进去一部分，头部也已出去，他此时进退两难，根本无法再退出来抵挡林云的攻击。
宝剑带着凌厉的威势，狠狠地扎进了黑斗袍男子的背部。
刹那间，一股汹涌澎湃的力量如洪流般奔涌而出，朝着黑斗袍男子疯狂肆虐而去。
“噗！”
黑斗袍男子口中喷出一口鲜血，脸色变得惨白无比。
尽管他的境界比林云略高一些，但也仅仅是小境界的差距而已。
而林云却有着，祖地天道所赋予的特殊优势，再加上他以肉身硬接这一击，黑斗袍男子自然难以抵挡。
“难道还想逃走不成？！”
林云迅速抽出宝剑，大喝一声，紧接着再次挥剑朝黑斗袍男子猛刺过去。
噗！
这一剑势大力沉，再度刺穿了黑斗袍男子的背部，甚至直接贯穿到了他的心脏部位！
“啊啊啊！”
content_en:
According to the words of the man in black robe, Lin Yun is almost certain that the source realm can indeed continue to improve!
As for the cosmic sea he mentioned, what kind of place is that?
These words contained so much information that Lin Yun could not fully digest them for a while.
Lin Yun's heart was already extremely surging at this moment, and the enthusiasm in his blood was already boiling!
"You're not entirely telling the truth."
Lin Yun stared at him.
"Believe it or not!"
After the man in black robe finished speaking, he turned around again and raised his hand to tear open the crack in the space.
Lin Yun was already prepared. When he tore open the crack, Lin Yun thought and quickly repaired the crack.
But this time, the man in black robe also learned wisely.
After he tore open the crack, he kept holding on to the crack with both hands. His arms exploded with all their strength, preventing Lin Yun from repairing the crack, and at the same time, he wanted to squeeze out!
"Boy, you just promised to let me go after I answer the questions!"
"What do you mean now?!"
The man in black robe was cursing angrily while trying his best to stop the crack from being repaired and pushing out.
"Why are you leaving in such a hurry? Since you are from outside, as the host, of course I have to entertain you well!"
Lin Yun raised the corners of his mouth.
After the words fell, the sword in Lin Yun's hand once again sparked with dazzling light. Infused with the power of the source, the energy of the source tree and the power of heaven, a sword swept towards the man in black robe.
Lin Yun refused to let him go for a simple reason. From the moment he first met him, Lin Yun could clearly feel that this guy coveted the ancestral land, especially the ancestral heart realm in front of him!
Lin Yun still didn't know the reason why he coveted it.
And this guy comes from the so-called cosmic sea.
Lin Yun guessed that there must be someone more powerful than him over there, and even a more powerful training system.
What if we let him go and he brings stronger people next time to occupy the ancestral land? What if we even start a war?
As the Heavenly Way of the ancestral land, I must have the obligation to protect the ancestral land.
What's more, all his relatives and friends are now in the ancestral land, and Lin Yun can't let any chance of anything happening to the ancestral land!
Tear it apart!
The sword turned into a bright sword light, and wherever it passed, the space collapsed, and it arrived in an instant.
The man in the black robe was digging at the crack in the space with his hands, and his whole body had already squeezed in partially, and his head had also come out. He was in a dilemma at this time, and could no longer withdraw to resist Lin Yun's attack.
The sword pierced the back of the man in black robe with fierce power.
In an instant, a surging force rushed out like a torrent, raging crazily towards the man in black robe.
"Poof!"
The man in black robe spurted a mouthful of blood, and his face turned extremely pale.
Although his realm is slightly higher than Lin Yun, the gap is only a small realm.
However, Lin Yun had the special advantage given by the Heavenly Way of the Ancestral Land. Coupled with the fact that he could resist the blow with his physical body, it was naturally difficult for the man in black robe to resist.
"Do you still want to escape?!"
Lin Yun quickly drew out his sword, shouted loudly, and then swung his sword again and stabbed at the man in black robe.
puff!
The sword was so powerful and heavy that it pierced the back of the man in black robe again, and even penetrated directly into his heart!
"Ahhh!"
